notices.title: Prime Minister Carney strengthens Canada’s alliance with Europe at the Summit of the European Political Community
notices.summary: For the past year and a half, Canada has forged a much deeper alliance with Europe. Last month, at the Canada-European Union (EU) Summit in Montréal, Prime Minister Carney, along with presidents von der Leyen and Costa, launched the Alliance for the Future – a coalition of nations focused on leveraging each other’s strengths to build resilience and reinforce our sovereignty. In parallel, Canada and the EU are working toward the deepest possible partnership – short of accession – with Canada becoming the EU’s first Associate Member. notices.title: Prime Minister Carney meets with Prime Minister of Greece Kyriakos Mitsotakis
notices.summary: Today, the Prime Minister, Mark Carney, met with the Prime Minister of Greece, Kyriakos Mitsotakis, on the margins of the Summit of the European Political Community, in Dublin, Ireland. Prime Minister Carney and Prime Minister Mitsotakis emphasised the close relationship between Canada and Greece, built on shared values and principles as well as strong people-to-people ties. They discussed opportunities to strengthen bilateral trade and investment, deepen commercial cooperation, and expand their partnership in areas of mutual interest. notices.title: Prime Minister Carney meets with President of Cyprus Nikos Christodoulides
notices.summary: Today, the Prime Minister, Mark Carney, met with the President of Cyprus, Nikos Christodoulides, on the margins of the Summit of the European Political Community, in Dublin, Ireland. The leaders reaffirmed the longstanding relationship between Canada and Cyprus, underpinned by shared democratic values, strong people-to-people ties, and a common commitment to international security and stability. notices.title: Statement by Prime Minister Carney on Remembrance Day
notices.summary: “Today, Canadians gather to honour the generations of women and men who answered the call. We remember those who spent years away from their loved ones, those who returned forever changed, and those who never came home.
